**Popular alternatives to Bloomerang, a donor management and fundraising CRM for nonprofits, include Givebutter, LiveImpact, Donorbox, Virtuous, Little Green Light, BetterWorld, DonorPerfect, Bonterra, CharityEngine, and Eleo.**[2][1][3][4]

These platforms offer similar or enhanced features like donor tracking, fundraising tools, reporting, and volunteer management, often at lower costs or with more customization than Bloomerang's starting price of $125/month.[1][2][3][4]

### Top Alternatives Comparison
| Alternative | Key Strengths | Pricing Notes | Best For |
|-------------|---------------|---------------|----------|
| **Givebutter** | Free all-in-one platform with unlimited donation forms, CRM, marketing, and 24/7 support; integrates with Bloomerang.[2] | Completely free (no monthly fees).[2] | Nonprofits seeking cost-free, comprehensive fundraising and donor management.[2] |
| **LiveImpact** | AI-powered donor insights, complex giving/pledges, moves management, integrated volunteer tools, custom fields/workflows.[1] | Affordable; serves nonprofits for 10+ years.[1] | Larger nonprofits needing advanced retention and customization.[1] |
| **BetterWorld** | No platform fees (keep 100% of funds), flexible donor/campaign/event management, user-friendly.[3] | Cost-effective vs. Bloomerang's high costs.[3] | Budget-conscious orgs prioritizing customization and full fund retention.[3] |
| **Donorbox** | Flexible payments (multi-currency, PayPal/Apple Pay), donation forms, events, crowdfunding; basic CRM.[2] | Lower cost focus.[2] | Fundraising-heavy nonprofits with global donors.[2] |
| **Virtuous** | Strong marketing automation, workflows, donor segmentation, volunteer management.[2] | Covers Bloomerang features plus more automation.[2] | Orgs emphasizing automated communications and major gifts.[2] |
| **Little Green Light** | Simple donor/volunteer management, customizable reports/dashboards, wide integrations; easy for volunteers.[2][7] | Lower cost, no complex modules.[2][7] | Small teams wanting streamlined, affordable essentials.[2][7] |
| **DonorPerfect** | Comprehensive donor management.[2][4] | Competitive pricing with user reviews.[4] | Established nonprofits needing robust CRM.[2] |
| **Bonterra (EveryAction)** | Full nonprofit CRM suite.[2][4] | Feature-rich competitor.[4] | Mid-to-large orgs with advocacy needs.[4] |
| **CharityEngine** | All-in-one fundraising/CRM.[2][8] | Strong in donor tools.[8] | Integrated operations.[2] |
| **Eleo** | Top-rated alternative per reviews.[4] | User-favored features/pricing.[4] | General donor management switchers.[4] |

Other options like DonorSnap, Sumac, Keela, OneCause, and NewOrg also rank highly in comparisons.[4][8] Choose based on needs: free/low-cost (Givebutter, BetterWorld), advanced AI/custom (LiveImpact), or simple/streamlined (Little Green Light).[1][2][3][7] Many provide free trials or demos for testing.[2][3]
